xcsh/21.11.8

command: bun packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts --help
xcsh v21.11.8

USAGE
  $ xcsh [COMMAND]

ARGUMENTS
  MESSAGES   Messages to send (prefix files with @)

FLAGS
      --model=<value>                 Model to use (fuzzy match: "opus", "gpt-5.2", or "p-openai/gpt-5.2")
      --smol=<value>                  Smol/fast model for lightweight tasks (or PI_SMOL_MODEL env)
      --slow=<value>                  Slow/reasoning model for thorough analysis (or PI_SLOW_MODEL env)
      --plan=<value>                  Plan model for architectural planning (or PI_PLAN_MODEL env)
      --provider=<value>              Provider to use (legacy; prefer --model)
      --context=<value>               Bind this session to a named F5 XC context
      --api-key=<value>               API key (defaults to env vars)
      --system-prompt=<value>         System prompt (default: coding assistant prompt)
      --append-system-prompt=<value>  Append text or file contents to the system prompt
      --allow-home                    Allow starting in ~ without auto-switching to a temp dir
      --no-sandbox                    Disable the session filesystem discovery guard
      --allow-path=<value>            Allow directory discovery at an additional path (repeatable)
      --mode=<value>                  Output mode: text (default), json, rpc, or acp
  -p, --print                         Non-interactive mode: process prompt and exit
  -c, --continue                      Continue previous session
  -r, --resume=<value>                Resume a session (by ID prefix, path, or picker if omitted)
      --fork=<value>                  Fork an existing session by ID prefix or path
      --session-dir=<value>           Directory for session storage and lookup
      --no-session                    Don't save session (ephemeral)
      --no-memories                   Disable project memory loading and maintenance
      --models=<value>                Comma-separated model patterns for Ctrl+P cycling
      --no-tools                      Disable all built-in tools
      --no-mcp                        Disable MCP server discovery and tools
      --no-lsp                        Disable LSP tools, formatting, and diagnostics
      --no-pty                        Disable PTY-based interactive bash execution
      --tools=<value>                 Comma-separated list of tools to enable (default: all)
      --thinking=<value>              Set thinking level: minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max
      --hook=<value>                  Load a hook/extension file (can be used multiple times)
  -e, --extension=<value>             Load an extension file (can be used multiple times)
      --plugin-dir=<value>            Load plugin from directory (repeatable)
      --no-extensions                 Disable extension discovery (explicit -e paths still work)
      --no-skills                     Disable skills discovery and loading
      --skills=<value>                Comma-separated glob patterns to filter skills (e.g., git-*,docker)
      --no-rules                      Disable rules discovery and loading
      --export=<value>                Export session file to HTML and exit
      --list-models=<value>           List available models (with optional fuzzy search)
      --no-title                      Disable title auto-generation

EXAMPLES
  # Interactive mode
    xcsh
  # Interactive mode with initial prompt
    xcsh "List all .ts files in src/"
  # Include files in initial message
    xcsh @prompt.md @image.png "What color is the sky?"
  # Non-interactive mode (process and exit)
    xcsh -p "List all .ts files in src/"
  # Continue previous session
    xcsh --continue "What did we discuss?"
  # Use different model (fuzzy matching)
    xcsh --model opus "Help me refactor this code"
  # Limit model cycling to specific models
    xcsh --models claude-sonnet,claude-haiku,gpt-4o
  # Export a session file to HTML
    xcsh --export ~/.xcsh/agent/sessions/--path--/session.jsonl

COMMANDS
  agents       Manage bundled task agents
  apply        Apply manifests by creating, updating, or preserving resources
  chrome       Inspect or arrange the Chrome session xcsh drives for console automation
  chrome-host  Native-messaging relay between Chrome and the xcsh manager socket (internal)
  commit       Generate a commit message and update changelogs
  config       Manage configuration settings
  create       Create resources from manifests and fail if they already exist
  delete       Delete resources identified by manifests or kind and name
  diff         Compare manifests with live resources without mutation
  export       Export live resources as manifests
  get          Get or list live resources
  grep         Test grep tool
  grievances   View reported tool issues (auto-QA grievances)
  herdr        Launch xcsh in a conversation-owned Herdr workspace

command: bun packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts config --help
Manage configuration settings

USAGE
  $ xcsh config [ACTION] [KEY] [VALUE] [FLAGS]

ARGUMENTS
  ACTION   Config action (list|get|set|reset|path|init-xdg)
  KEY      Setting key
  VALUE    Value (for set/reset)

FLAGS
      --json  Output JSON
